hero.title: Say it once, share it forever

hero.quote: "Hold onto memories; they will hold onto you."

sharedCta: ✨ You received a Wispr Story! Tap Create my card to make your own.
ffNotice: 🌐 Voice recording is not supported in Firefox. Use Chrome or Safari — or paste your text below.

record.label: 1 · Tap to speak
record.tip: Press record and speak naturally. Your words appear live. Tap again to stop — your words move into the text box ready for the card.
record.sub: Your words appear as you speak

orText: or type or paste your words

textarea.label: 2 · Your words
textarea.tip: Speak first using Record above — words land here automatically. Or type directly. Or paste from Wispr Flow. Any language works here.
textarea.placeholder: Record your voice or type anything: a birthday wish, memory, recipe, love letter, gratitude, advice...

nameRow.label: From
nameRow.placeholder: e.g. Mom, Durga, Taylor, Sensei, Abuela, P'Lisa, Ella...

tone.label: 3 · Tone
tone.tip: Original preserves your exact words — unlimited, no daily cap. Other tones rewrite via AI: Warm is gentle, Bold is direct, Poetic flows with rhythm, Playful is light, Reflective is slow, Honest is raw. Changes letter-spacing and slant only — not size or weight.

color.label: 4 · Card color
color.tip: Sets the card background. The live preview updates instantly.

shape.label: 5 · Shape
shape.tip: Sharp edges work best for WhatsApp. Rounded corners suit galleries and web.

cardEmpty:
Fill the details —
your card appears here
cardPlaceholder: Your story appears here as you speak or type.

wcta.text: Use your voice anywhere you type — WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack, any app.

capacity.title: We're overwhelmed with love!
capacity.text: Thank you for the incredible response. We've reached our daily capacity and need to give our servers a little rest.
capacity.reset: We'll be back at midnight UTC.
